# Claude Code fixtures

Synthetic fixtures for the Claude Code adapter. Every value is invented:
paths are under `/Users/alice/...`, ids are fake, the PNG is a 1x1 placeholder.
Generated by a one-off script; edit the fixture files directly if needed.

Layout mirrors `~/.claude/projects/`:

```
projects/
  -Users-alice-code-demo-app/
    11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.jsonl                     main session (feature map below)
    11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/subagents/agent-abc123.jsonl
    11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/subagents/agent-abc123.meta.json
    11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/tool-results/toolu_big1.txt
    memory/project_notes.md         must be ignored by the parser
  -Users-alice-code-other/
    22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222.jsonl               second small session
```

Line numbers are 1-based within `projects/-Users-alice-code-demo-app/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111.jsonl`. UUIDs are the fake ids the script assigned.

## Sub-agent (`subagents/agent-abc123.jsonl`)

- `isSidechain: true` and `agentId: "abc123"` on every record.
- `agent-abc123.meta.json`: `agentType` general-purpose, `toolUseId` toolu_agent1, `model` sonnet.
- Uses a Bash tool_use and a text reply.

## Tool results (`tool-results/toolu_big1.txt`)

Referenced from the `<persisted-output>` string in U3 (line 19).

## Second session (`-Users-alice-code-other/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222.jsonl`)

Custom-title plus four user/assistant turns in a different project.

## Ignored content

- `memory/project_notes.md` is a plain markdown file. It must not be parsed as a chat.

## Expected parser behaviour

- Every line parses as JSON except line 18.
- Line 22 is an unknown type. It must not crash the parser.
